title: Audit source calendar semantics and definition gaps

acceptance.text: Compare all 13 collected Lentil regions and inspect originals for observed month-label gaps.
acceptance.evidence: Compared all 13 collected Lentil regions. Four original PDF headers (Dhaka, Faridpur, Mymensingh, Rajshahi) were visually inspected after matching pinned source hashes; all print December followed by February over week-label reset 52 to 1. No source month, week, duration or weather value corrected.
acceptance.how: Use physical source columns, verify original PDF hashes and inspect rendered headers; retain all source values.
acceptance.verification: All regions retained; inspected findings identify exact PDF/page without inferred month corrections or ISO dates.

acceptance.text: Audit all 318 extracted documents for definition and temporal-wording leads with source-role separation.
acceptance.evidence: Audited all 318 preserved documents across 14 regions. Recorded 320 raw interval-wording rows with source page/table/row/cell references and inactive role leads; English definition patterns had no matches, which is explicitly not proof of absent definitions. acceptance.how: Retain raw source rows and page/table/cell references; record web-source checks and unresolved definitions.
acceptance.verification: Pest/disease and warning intervals cannot activate crop rules or define normal-weather aggregation.

acceptance.text: Verify preservation and deterministic audit outputs; hand off for independent review.
